cards.script: Alone in a city where you don't speak the language. Every street is your decision. Choose your travel eSIM before you go, so finding your way is your call. Openline.com.

cards.title: Iceland Coastal Detour
cards.description: Two friends standing beside their SUV on an Icelandic coastal road reading a detour sign, then driving a gravel track past black-sand cliffs at golden hour. Revised with word-by-word captions, a compact AI badge and a spacious outro.
cards.script: The road you planned is closed. Nobody argues. Somebody just turns toward the coast. Trips change. Choose a destination eSIM before you leave, and be ready for detours. Get yours at Openline.com.
cards.disclosure: AI-generated scenes and narration, not real customer footage. The on-video AI circle remains visible after the introductory label fades. No network-performance or pricing evidence is implied.

cards.title: Cape Town Café: Choosing Your Plan
cards.description: A woman sits at a sunny Cape Town café table with an open notebook and a face-down phone, calmly comparing travel data plan options before closing the notebook with a satisfied smile. Revised with word-by-word captions, a compact AI badge and a spacious outro.
cards.script: One plan doesn't suit every trip, so she writes down her options first. Openline lists destination plans and partner-network choices. Compare them calmly. Your trip, your call. Openline.com.

cards.title: Hellen · continuity pilot
cards.description: A 12-second test of a fictional AI presenter, Hellen, featuring a single continuous take with a fixed synthetic voice. This is a pilot only, not the full installation tutorial.
cards.disclosure: Hellen introduces an Openline tutorial covering both QR code and manual eSIM setup. The audio was synthesized in one pass and drives a single avatar render, with no presenter joins or speed edits. The voice is a new, unapproved synthetic American female voice, distinct from earlier Veo clips. A burned-in caption bar was added locally, masking the model's own garbled lower-third text.

metadata.name: Openline: Travel eSIM & Data
metadata.subtitle: Travel data, in your hands
metadata.promotional: Find an eSIM for your next trip. Compare plan details, follow the setup steps and keep your travel data in view.
metadata.description:
Your next trip starts with a plan.

Browse travel eSIMs for your destination, compare the details and keep your plans in one place with Openline.

Find a plan for your trip
Explore available plans and compare their data allowance, duration and price. Check coverage and activation conditions before you buy.

Keep setup within reach
Find your purchase code and installation information, then follow the setup steps for your phone and plan.

See your travel data
View your eSIMs and the usage information shown for each plan. Availability and usage reporting vary by plan.

A market behind your plan
The Openline Mobile Data Market (OMDM) compares supplier offers to build our travel-plan catalog. Your available choices depend on the destination and current offers.

Before you go
You'll need an eSIM-compatible, network-unlocked phone. Check each plan's validity, activation timing, fair-use terms and included services. Calls, texts and a phone number are included only where the plan says so. Your home carrier may charge you if you keep your usual line active.

Mobile data plans are purchased separately. For support information, visit openline.com.
